IDENTITY_KEYS = ("slug", "display_name", "description", "priority", "upgrade", "availability_nux")


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def build_unified_catalog() -> dict:
    cache = load_json(CACHE_PATH)
    old = load_json(OLD_CATALOG) if OLD_CATALOG.exists() else {"models": []}
    cache_by = {m["slug"]: m for m in cache.get("models") or [] if m.get("slug")}
    old_by = {m["slug"]: m for m in old.get("models") or [] if m.get("slug")}

    # Prefer existing catalog entry shape; fill missing (esp. sol) from nearest template.
    template = old_by.get("gpt-5.6-terra") or old_by.get("gpt-5.6-luna") or next(iter(old_by.values()), None)
    if template is None:
        # fallback: strip cache-only fields later
        template = next(iter(cache_by.values()))

    catalog_fields = set(template.keys())
    models = []
    for slug in WANTED_ORDER:
        src_cache = cache_by.get(slug)
        src_old = old_by.get(slug)
        if src_old is not None:
            entry = deepcopy(src_old)
        elif src_cache is not None:
            entry = deepcopy(template)
            for k in IDENTITY_KEYS:
                if k in src_cache:
                    entry[k] = deepcopy(src_cache[k])
            # keep only catalog-shaped keys
            entry = {k: entry[k] for k in catalog_fields if k in entry}
            # ensure required identity
            entry["slug"] = slug
            entry["display_name"] = src_cache.get("display_name") or slug
            if "description" in src_cache:
                entry["description"] = src_cache["description"]
            entry["visibility"] = "list"
            entry["supported_in_api"] = True
        else:
            print("WARN missing model in cache/catalog:", slug)
            continue
        # force visible in picker
        entry["visibility"] = "list"
        entry["supported_in_api"] = True
        models.append(entry)

    # Append any other cache models not in wanted list (future-proof), still list-visible
    for slug, m in cache_by.items():
        if slug in WANTED_ORDER:
            continue
        entry = deepcopy(template)
        for k in IDENTITY_KEYS:
            if k in m:
                entry[k] = deepcopy(m[k])
        entry = {k: entry[k] for k in catalog_fields if k in entry}
        entry["slug"] = slug
        entry["display_name"] = m.get("display_name") or slug
        entry["visibility"] = "list"
        entry["supported_in_api"] = True
        models.append(entry)

    return {"models": models}


def upsert_top_key(config: str, key: str, value_line: str) -> str:
    pattern = rf"(?m)^{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*.+$"
    if re.search(pattern, config):
        return re.sub(pattern, value_line, config, count=1)
    # insert after model= if present, else at top after comments/schema
    m = re.search(r"(?m)^model\s*=\s*.+$", config)
    if m:
        pos = m.end()
        return config[:pos] + "\n" + value_line + config[pos:]
    return value_line + "\n" + config


def patch_provider_config(config: str) -> str:
    config = upsert_top_key(config, "model_catalog_json", f'model_catalog_json = "{CATALOG_REL}"')
    return config


def main() -> None:
    ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
    backup_dir = CODEX / "backups" / f"unified-model-catalog-{ts}"
    backup_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    if OLD_CATALOG.exists():
        shutil.copy2(OLD_CATALOG, backup_dir / OLD_CATALOG.name)
    if LIVE.exists():
        shutil.copy2(LIVE, backup_dir / "config.toml")
    shutil.copy2(DB, backup_dir / "cc-switch.db")

    unified = build_unified_catalog()
    CATALOG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    CATALOG_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(unified, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    # also refresh old path so any leftover refs still work
    OLD_CATALOG.write_text(json.dumps(unified, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    slugs = [m["slug"] for m in unified["models"]]
    print("catalog_slugs:", slugs)
    print("catalog_path:", CATALOG_PATH)

    con = sqlite3.connect(str(DB))
    cur = con.cursor()
    updated = []
    for pid, name, cfg_raw in cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, name, settings_config FROM providers WHERE app_type='codex'"
    ):
        if pid not in THIRD_PARTY_IDS:
            continue
        data = json.loads(cfg_raw)
        conf = data.get("config") or ""
        new_conf = patch_provider_config(conf)
        if new_conf != conf:
            data["config"] = new_conf
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE providers SET settings_config=? WHERE id=? AND app_type='codex'",
                (json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), pid),
            )
            updated.append(name)
        else:
            # still report
            updated.append(name + "(unchanged?)")
    con.commit()

    # live config.toml: point to unified catalog
    live = LIVE.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    live2 = upsert_top_key(live, "model_catalog_json", f'model_catalog_json = "{CATALOG_REL}"')
    if live2 != live:
        LIVE.write_text(live2, encoding="utf-8")
        print("live_config: model_catalog_json updated")
    else:
        print("live_config: model_catalog_json already set / rewritten check")
        LIVE.write_text(live2, encoding="utf-8")

    print("providers_updated:", updated)
    print("backup:", backup_dir)

    # verify
    live_v = LIVE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(r'(?m)^model_catalog_json\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', live_v)
    print("verify_live_catalog:", m.group(1) if m else None)
    for pid in sorted(THIRD_PARTY_IDS):
        row = cur.execute(
            "SELECT name, settings_config FROM providers WHERE id=? AND app_type='codex'",
            (pid,),
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            print("missing provider", pid)
            continue
        conf = json.loads(row[1]).get("config") or ""
        cm = re.search(r'(?m)^model_catalog_json\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', conf)
        mm = re.search(r'(?m)^model\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', conf)
        print(f"verify {row[0]}: model={mm.group(1) if mm else None} catalog={cm.group(1) if cm else None}")
    con.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
'@
$path = "$env:TEMP\unify_codex_model_catalog.py"
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $script, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
& $py $path
